items.raw_excerpt: The Auckland electorate seat of Mount Albert could prove to be pivotal for National as it plots it way back to power.

items.raw_excerpt: Despite growing awareness and gradual improvements in building retrofit programmes, most New Zealand homes aren’t designed for people with dementia.
items.summary_en: About 83,000 people in New Zealand live with dementia. Most homes are not designed to help them. Retrofitting homes with simple design changes can make daily life safer and easier.

items.raw_excerpt: Waiting for a residency permit or visa to come through when living in another country can be a hugely stressful experience. Several foreign residents in France, who are caught up in lengthy or unpredictable permit renewal procedures, told The Local about how the uncertainty has hit their daily lives.
items.summary_en: Some foreign residents in France must wait a long time for residence permits to be renewed. The long wait makes everyday life stressful. Some of them say they cannot risk leaving France because their permit is still being processed.

items.title_en: Foreign residents in France wait months for residence permits

items.raw_excerpt: These rather flimsy looking pieces of paper carry a lot of weight in France - here is everything you should know about récépissés.
